Probably a good seafood place
Mar 2025 • Friends
I went here yesterday and ordered a Vietnamese hot pot with sprouts, cabbage and tofu to place into the broth. They have tanks of live seafood like fish, crabs and lobster. It is quite pricey compared to other places. It is a chinese restaurant with a fusion of that a some western and Vietnamese dishes. 

The hot pot broth was luke warm and was placed on the cooking element (which wasn’t even turned on). The waitress checked it for heat initially and as time went on the broth didn’t heat up (going from luke warm to cold). It was difficult to cook the vegetables and tofu in the hot pot.

I also ordered rice but when we spotted that it wasn’t coming it was because of a misunderstanding (the hot pot is supposed to come with rice or noodles. As the menu is in Việtnamese I had translated it). So I ended up ordering rice for a small fee but it pretty much came out when the hot pot had gone cold. 

The waitress tried her best and most communication was done via translator. It is a Chinese run restaurant so best to check which language to communicate in if using a translator app. 

The hygiene is questionable. I used the toilets and they would benefit from a clean. I walked past a couple of rooms to get to yhe bathroom and the floor was sticky, there was a room full of dishes, plates etc spread on the floor. It did leave me feeling worried about food being cooked here in those conditions. 

I wouldn’t go back here but based on reviews it’s a good place for seafood dishes.
